integrity: All formulas in the claim, proof, and review use the same model and centering; reproducibility code and observed output are embedded. No external scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Critical geometric offspring with extinction, deterministic immigration floor(c k^alpha), fixed c>0 and alpha>0 only. No universality for other offspring laws, random environments, alpha=0, or varying parameters. Infinite theorem follows from the explicit law and rare-event proof; finite checks are supplementary. Priority remains subject to independent specialist evaluation.
title: Gumbel extremes and Gamma founder-time localization for polynomially immigrating critical branching clans
